title: SvgTspan
responsibility: Renders the native tspan element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgTspan.attributes
inputs.description: Native tspan attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgTspan.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native tspan element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgTspan
outputs.description: The actual native tspan element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
